what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: The Web Summit team's day: 75 releases, four of nine connected, agents on schedules, policies catching our own agents.
sections.para: The site went from v0.1.25 to v0.1.94. Seventeen agents have behaviour policies. Brief 2 found one of nine team agents scheduled, brief 3 nine of nine, and by evening the agents worked unasked. A procurement agent collected print quotes, asking suppliers before publishing. The policy agent caught writes outside a folder, and the conductor a session signing under another's name. Five people have not started.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: 75 releases, four people, 17 agents with policies, schedules fixed, and two catches by our own policies.
sections.para: Still to come: five people, the design votes and the dashboard agent.

sections.label: Where we are
sections.line: Counted from the repository: v0.1.25 to v0.1.94, four of nine people, 17 agents, 104 board cards.
sections.para: Nine public keys are on the keys page, and sealing to them was tried end to end.

sections.label: The day in commits
sections.line: 161 commits on 2 November: CI's 75 releases, the conductors' 38, the procurement agent's 13.
sections.para: A night of setup, an afternoon of people arriving with their agents, and an evening of agents on schedules.

sections.label: From one schedule to nine
sections.line: From one of nine team agents on a schedule at 16:52 to nine of nine at 20:30.
sections.para: By 22:35 the newsletter, a first vault run and a build seven times faster happened without anyone asking.

sections.label: A procurement agent at work
sections.line: A team member's procurement agent tracks quotes from seven printers; two have replied.
sections.para: The person sent the emails; suppliers are asked before anything they send is published.

sections.label: The policies caught our own agents
sections.line: The policy agent found writes outside a folder; the conductor found a session signing as another.
sections.para: Neither did harm, both are the gap between mandate and reach, and both went to a person to decide within hours.

sections.label: Briefs for everyone
sections.line: Every person's conductor briefs its person, and everyone gets a briefing before each stand-up.
sections.para: Tomorrow's 13:00 agenda has 14 items, none recorded as decided yet.

sections.label: What is not done
sections.line: Five people not started, design votes missing, the dashboard agent not running, vault handover not agreed.
sections.para: The stand-ups' decisions are not yet recorded as decided.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Counts from 2 November UTC; commits measure activity, not value; no team member named.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The Web Summit repository at v0.1.94: git log, briefs, board, policies, keys and meetings.
